content.text: Fighting the first wave. Kicking the enemy coming in from the north.
Two kills so far, and the first debris block has landed near the centre. I'll keep fighting next to it so the pile builds into a ramp.
Four fodder are closing in. Kicking the nearest one to the north-northeast.
HP is down to 52 and the kicks keep missing, so I'm switching to punches, which lock onto the nearest target.
The dash-then-kick lands hits on several of them, so I'll keep repeating it.
6 kills so far. The debris gets scattered, so once this wave is cleared I'll carry the blocks into a pile by hand.
Still clearing fodder (HP 36). Finishing off a weakened one to the north.
Good kick: one kill and two others hurt. Now the 4 HP one to the north-northeast.

detail: clearing fodder in Escape the Box; 6 kills, HP 36

content.text: HP 20 with four fodder and a thug coming. Dashing away to dodge the incoming swing.
HP 12, surrounded. Trying to grab one and spin-throw it into the crowd.

I died in box 1 with 8 kills and no escapes: the crowd of fodder kept out-trading me, the debris scattered instead of piling up, and once a thug arrived I was cornered at 12 HP (the pile grid also briefly showed bogus ~2e31 heights, which I didn't try to use).
